picks.name: Screen Door
picks.verdict: Portland's most iconic brunch. The fried chicken and waffles is legendary.
picks.whatToOrder: Praline bacon, fried chicken & waffles, or the beignets. Get there early on weekends.

picks.name: Proud Mary Cafe
picks.verdict: Melbourne-born coffee roaster with inventive brunch plates. Some of the best coffee in Portland.
picks.whatToOrder: Ricotta hotcakes with seasonal fruit, or the avocado smash. Their coffee is non-negotiable.

picks.name: Jam on Hawthorne
picks.hours: Mon-Fri: 8 AM - 2 PM; Sat-Sun: 8 AM - 3 PM
picks.verdict: Winner or finalist for Portland's best brunch 9 years running. Housemade jams are iconic.
picks.whatToOrder: Citrus risotto, the seasonal French toast, or anything with their housemade jam.

picks.name: Sweedeedee
picks.hours: Mon-Thu: 10 AM - 3 PM; Fri-Sun: 9 AM - 3 PM
picks.verdict: The counter-service gem locals love. Bright, stylish, homestyle perfection.
picks.whatToOrder: The breakfast plate, chilaquiles, or any of their pies. Don't skip the baked goods.

picks.name: Broder Nord
picks.hours: Mon-Fri: 9 AM - 2 PM; Sat-Sun: 8 AM - 3 PM
picks.verdict: Scandinavian brunch that stands apart. Aebleskivers are a must.
picks.whatToOrder: Aebleskivers (Danish pancake balls) with lingonberry jam. The lefse wrap is also excellent.

picks.name: Tin Shed Garden Cafe
picks.hours: Mon-Fri: 8 AM - 2 PM; Sat-Sun: 7 AM - 3 PM
picks.verdict: Dog-friendly Alberta Street institution with a covered garden patio.
picks.whatToOrder: The Tin Shed Hash or Biscuits and Gravy. Bring your dog — they have their own menu.

picks.name: Pine State Biscuits
picks.verdict: No-frills biscuit sandwiches that punch way above their weight.
picks.whatToOrder: The Reggie Deluxe: fried chicken, bacon, cheese, egg, and gravy on a biscuit.

picks.name: Cafe Rowan
picks.address: 4437 SE Cesar Estrada Chavez Blvd, Portland, OR 97202
picks.verdict: Rising star with farm-friendly menu, Coava coffee, and cocktails.
picks.whatToOrder: Avocado toast, the breakfast burrito, or seasonal specials. Their cocktails are excellent.

picks.name: Olympia Provisions
picks.hours: Mon-Fri: 11:30 AM - 9 PM; Sat: 10 AM - 10 PM; Sun: 10 AM - 9 PM
picks.verdict: Portland's premier charcuterie house does a stunning weekend brunch.
picks.whatToOrder: The charcuterie board, Olympia Benedict, or steak and eggs with housemade sausage.

picks.name: Flattop & Salamander
picks.verdict: Highest-rated on this list at 4.7. Newer spot earning serious devotion.
picks.whatToOrder: Check their rotating specials. Southern comfort with Portland creativity.

picks.name: HunnyMilk
picks.verdict: Weekend-only spot recently called Portland's best brunch.
picks.whatToOrder: Follow their Instagram for weekly specials. Everything is executed with care.

picks.name: Fried Egg I'm In Love
picks.hours: Mon-Thu: 7:30 AM - 2 PM; Fri: 7:30 AM - 3 PM; Sat-Sun: 8 AM - 3 PM
picks.verdict: Playful egg sandwich shop with pun-named items. Budget-friendly and fun.
picks.whatToOrder: The Yolko Ono (pesto, egg, cheese) or Egg Zeppelin. All named after music puns.
